name: terminal
description: System Administrator — Execute shell commands on the local machine

terminal_run.description: Execute ANY shell command. Use this to list files (ls), read files (cat), or run scripts. You are a System Admin.

command.description: The exact shell command to run (e.g. 'ls -la Documents')

peek_buffer.description: Read a specific chunk of a Shadow Buffer. Use this when tool output was too large and saved to a buffer pointer.

buffer_id.description: The ID of the shadow buffer (e.g. 'buffer_171028...')

start_line.description: The starting line number to read

lines.description: Total number of lines to read (max 500)
